'''Jonathan Colby''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th at [[February 2001 Rochester tournament (10 February)]] on 10 February 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step/Cantina Brawl]], according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1727">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-rochester-ny-2-10-2001d1727/ rochester-ny-2-10-2001], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-rochester-ny-2-10-2001d1727/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
